description: Raised for any invalid or missing configuration value encountered by load_settings, validate_parameters or load_parameters. The single error type all of config's fallible entry points raise, so callers (orchestration's startup assertion, scripts/verify_parameters_consistency.py) can catch one exception type.
signature:
class ParameterError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, *, path: Path | None = None, key: str | None = None) -> None: ...
docstring:
Configuration/parameter validation failure.

Args:
    message: Human-readable, English-language description of what was wrong.
    path: The file the error pertains to, if applicable (e.g. the missing or malformed parameters.toml).
    key: The dotted section.key path of the offending value, if applicable (e.g. 'enrichment.storefront_cut').

Attributes:
    message, path, key are stored verbatim and included in str(err) so a run's error_message column (runs.error_message) captures enough detail to diagnose without re-running.
postconditions: str(ParameterError(...)) includes message, and path/key when provided, in a single readable line

edge_cases.input: ParameterError('bad value') with no path or key

edge_cases.expected_behavior: str() includes all three pieces, e.g. 'out of range (parameters.toml: enrichment.storefront_cut)'

unit_tests.name: test_str_with_path_and_key
unit_tests.description: Full context renders in a single readable string.
